notes: REL606 (B). Base medium and its composition are not given (only carbon source and Mg/Na levels), so base_medium/medium_class/amino_acids_supplied left out; temperature, oxygen, culture mode not given. Phase from ch:growth phase as stated (exponential samples up to 14 h on glycerol taken as stated). Gluconate and lactate -> organic_acid. Treatments: highNa -> hyperosmotic, highMg (8-400 mM) -> metal_excess, lowMg (<=0.08 mM) -> metal_limitation; exposure adapted inferred because samples were taken >=5 h into growth in the condition (when the salt was added is not stated). All base Na/base Mg samples (any carbon source, any phase) are controls per the several-reference-conditions rule; the study names glucose/5 mM Na/0.8 mM Mg as its reference. WT re-read: unmodified REL606, so wild_type.
